title: FIG. 08 · Handover kit
summary: FIG. 08 takes the true three-piece Kelwin mark apart at its joins and knolls the five solid parts into a three-compartment tray, one compartment per capability, beside the mark's own assembly drawing, so 'what you own' becomes a numbered kit you can see rather than today's manifest table and terms card.

reference.site: FREITAG: 'The FREITAG process at a glance'
reference.borrowed: FREITAG's 'one plate, one key' structure: a single full-width flat plate holds the whole operation as one drawing, small numbered markers sit on each station, and the names live only in a numbered key below. No cards, no photography.
reference.kelwin: The drawing becomes FIG. 08, a flat --panel plate with A's caption band and a Plurel segmented control (Installed | Handed over). The plate is a parts tray whose two partition walls sit on the col 4|5 and 8|9 gutters, so the tray's three compartments are exactly the three key strips below. The mark (152-unit master, 1.5 px per unit) is cut at its own joins into five solid parts, and every part keeps its height in the mark, so the tray steps down like the logo. Narrative systems holds K1's two limbs in paper (01, 02). GTM infrastructure holds K2's two limbs in blush (03, 04). GTM intelligence holds the K3 core, the plate's one red element (05), beside the mark's 1px assembly drawing with dashed joins (06, Rebuild Sequence). Each part sits in an 8px cut-out. FREITAG's circled numbers become squared mono markers, numbers only, so no name is printed twice. The key is three Metalab strips grouped by capability, each item a numbered 28px wide title with the source line and a mono format. The head echoes the hero: a red-square caps label, a 96px two-voice statement, the 48×2 red rule and the lede below it, with the source coda ('If it stops working the day we leave, we built it wrong.') as the bottom-right annotation, '■ The handover test'. There is no red button: the act's one red element is the K3 core.

motion: entrance: the label fades in (300ms); the act opens on a hard cut from the paper 'fit' act above. The two statement lines rise out of masks (800ms --ease-out, the light line 320ms later), the red rule draws, and the lede and the annotation fade up 12px. The plate fades in on the 1px assembly drawing. The four limbs then slide onto that drawing from the top-right, one at a time (700ms, 120ms stagger), and the red core lands last (400ms). That landing is the 'installed' beat: the running system, assembled, with the five empty numbered cut-outs waiting in the tray. The strips rise in a 90ms cascade.

state change (the one orchestrated moment): at 2.5s the control advances Installed → Handed over. Every part slides sideways only, along its own row, out of the assembly and into its cut-out (900ms --ease-inout, 120ms stagger, right limbs first). The long limbs pass under the short ones, and the red core leaves last. The numbered markers brighten as their parts seat, and the 1px assembly drawing stays behind in the third compartment, which is the copy's point: when we leave, the system stays. The sequence comes to rest at about 4.3s.
ambient: none. The hero film is the page's only loop.

interaction: the segmented control is live and slides the parts onto the drawing or back into the tray. Hovering a key strip raises its titles to --fg, lifts its compartment to --panel-2, brightens its cut-outs and inverts its markers.
on the live site: the plate advances Installed → Handed over once, when it is 50% visible. prefers-reduced-motion shows the final Handed over state with no entrance.
notes: Critique pass: the six identical ghost-mark bays read as a template feature row, and every asset name was printed twice, once as a plate tag and once as a strip title. The plate was rebuilt as one knolled tray, three compartments keyed to the three capabilities (Narrative systems, GTM infrastructure, GTM intelligence, the K1–K3 mapping from the logo correction). To group by capability the source order is changed slightly: Channel Playbooks is now 02 and ICP & Signal Map is now 03. The head now follows the founder spec (96px, --display-tracking, a Mona caps label, the red rule), and every strip line is verbatim from AssetInventory.tsx. The lede's second sentence is rewritten to 'Six assets, handed over complete.' Coherence pass: the lede moved from the statement's right to under the red rule, the closing coda row became the head's annotation (the quiet link to /audit went with it; the audit is reachable from the hero, fit, FAQ and CTA), and the tray floor moved up 28px (plate 420px) so the act holds A's 112/96 rhythm at about 1380px. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
